note: Structured mirror of DWS_BRAND_STANDARD.md §23 (canonical 4P Capital Classes terminology). Lets scripts/lint-truth-claims.mjs and /truth-check flag the deprecated 'three-capital model' / 'Token Capital' / 'Control Room Capital' phrasing in new public-layer copy. 'Human Capital' is intentionally WARN-only (ambiguous) to avoid false positives on legitimate DESI / labour-economics citations.

canonicalTerminology.order: Prompt, People, Plant, Perception (fixed mnemonic order — never reorder)

classes.definition: The codified intelligence — validated prompts, skills, agent configs, eval datasets, automation.
Calibrated operator judgment from the HIL phase; the human-in-the-loop → human-in-control promotion.
The sovereign, mobile two-room stack (Control Room + Situation Room) — at a site or in a fleet vehicle.
The governed world model + closed sense→decide→act loop (sensors, mobility, satellite, robotics). The only class with data-network effects and a physical-AI character — the re-rate lever.

deprecatedDisplayPhrases: Token, Human and Control Room Capital

ambiguousDisplayPhrasesNeedingContext.validIf: DWS 4P context only — must appear alongside 'Perception', 'Prompt', 'Plant', 'agentic', or 'Firehorse'. Then it is a deprecated alias for 'People Capital'; use the canonical name.
ambiguousDisplayPhrasesNeedingContext.invalidIf: Generic HR, labour-economics, CSRD S1, or DESI/index citation context — leave untouched, it is not the DWS capital class.

ambiguousDisplayPhrasesNeedingContext.validIf: Deprecated alias for Prompt Capital. Valid only as a citation or historical reference — must appear alongside 'formerly', 'Nadella', or 'historical'. In new primary copy use the canonical Prompt Capital name.
ambiguousDisplayPhrasesNeedingContext.invalidIf: Used as a primary term in new positioning / investor / sales copy without the parenthetical.

ambiguousDisplayPhrasesNeedingContext.validIf: Deprecated alias for Plant Capital. Valid only as a citation or historical reference — must appear alongside 'formerly' or 'historical'. In new primary copy use the canonical Plant Capital name.
ambiguousDisplayPhrasesNeedingContext.invalidIf: Used as a primary term in new positioning / investor / sales copy without the parenthetical.
